cases: fibonacci(10) is the first ten numbers

assistant.context: A single file exercise. fibonacci.js has stub functions fibonacci(n) (first n Fibonacci numbers as an array) and fibonacciUpTo(limit) (numbers below limit) plus a few console.log checks at the bottom. It runs with `node fibonacci.js` and exports both functions with module.exports. The tests are in fibonacci.test.js (Node's built in test runner, `node --test fibonacci.test.js`, the Run tests button does the same); they fail until the functions are implemented. There are no dependencies. description.md is the brief the candidate reads first.
